run with no --cpus and no --memory on cgroup v2, in its own cgroup namespace,
on a host of 16 CPUs and 62.8 GiB; written by hand in the forms of the
kernel's cgroup-v2.rst, not captured. The main session captures one with
docker run or podman run in the build image (T-480's Done).
